reason: ajv 8 marks `unicode` deprecated but still honours `unicode: false`, which compiles minLength and maxLength to `.length` (UTF-16, as Effect's length checks count) instead of a `require("ajv/dist/runtime/ucs2length")` that crashes the ESM build (#33).
